notes.title: Mouse Inversion Added!
notes.content: We’ve heard you! In the latest update, you can now invert the Y-axis for mouse controls. Customize the controls to fit your playstyle and enjoy the game your way. Thanks to our community for the feedback — your suggestions help us make the game better!

notes.title: 🕯️ Update v1.0.2 - Home is getting closer 🕯️
notes.content:
Hello friends!

We continue to listen to your feedback and improve [b]House of Lost Souls[/b] to make your immersion into Jack's story even more exciting and comfortable.

🔧 [b]What's new in this update:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Simplified controls and interaction with the environment[/b] - exploring the house is now easier and more intuitive.
[*] [b]Fixed achievement[/b] - previously unavailable achievement now works correctly.
[*] [b]Optimization improved by 60%[/b] - the game is noticeably smoother and more stable.
[*] [b]Small visual fixes[/b] - details have been improved to make the atmosphere even more immersive.[/list]
Thank you for your support and feedback! We appreciate each and every one of you and continue to work on making your stay even more memorable.


Love,
[b]Arkuda Inc.[/b]

notes.title: Update v1.0.1 — thank you for your support!
notes.content:
Hi, friends!

We haven't been idle since the release - all this time the team has been actively dealing with the issues you've reported. Thank you for your patience, feedback and kind words - they are very important to us!

Today we are releasing v1.0.1 update, in which we have tried to take into account all the most acute issues:
📱 Added device selection for correct game display.
🔧 Fixed graphics settings, now they are saved correctly.
🌟 New options: brightness adjustment, mouse sharpness and other.
💾 Fixed saves.
🌍 Improved localization.
🕹️ Added useful little things to simplify controls.
🚀 Expanded range of graphical settings and improved optimization at different quality levels.

We are still working and are already preparing the next update. Thank you for being with us!

Your Team 
Arkuda Inc.

notes.title: Tonight at 9:00 PM MSK — the release of House of Lost Souls!
notes.content:
The long-awaited [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636000/House_of_Lost_Souls/]House of Lost Souls[/url] launches tonight at 9:00 PM Moscow time — a story-driven horror game that will immerse you in a dark and haunting tale.

At the heart of the story is Jack, who returns to his old family home in search of answers.
You’ll explore distorted memories, uncover grim secrets, and learn the truth about the tragedy that changed his life forever.

Get ready for a chilling journey through the shadows of the past — [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636000/House_of_Lost_Souls/]House of Lost Souls[/url] opens its doors tonight. Don’t miss it!

notes.title: Supporting the Debut: MosGhost by Sinka Games
notes.content:
Ahead of tomorrow's release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636000/House_of_Lost_Souls/]House of Lost Souls[/url], we’d like to share the exciting debut of our friends at Sinka Games — their first game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265370/MosGhost/]MosGhost[/url]! If you want to support the project and learn more, visit the game’s page by clicking on its title.

Thank you for your support and attention!

notes.title: The horror game will be released in early April
notes.content:
We originally planned to release the project earlier, but we will need a little more time to fix bugs. The game is bigger than we expected and needs time for playtesting. 

Thank you for your support and patience!

notes.title: ⚡️ Release Postponement: The game will be released on March 24 ⚡️
notes.content:
Friends, we would like to announce an important news: the release of our horror game is postponed to March 24.

This decision was not made spontaneously: we need some more time for testing and finalizing the last changes.

We are very grateful for your support and patience. We hope for your understanding - all this is done to make the game exactly what you are waiting for. We are sure that your waiting will be rewarded!

Stay tuned and be ready for a terrifying adventure very soon!

notes.title: Demo patch: key fixes and new sounds
notes.content:
[b]Dear friends![/b]

We carefully read all your messages, reviews and watch videos on YouTube. Your opinion is very important to us and we are glad that you share your impressions. Today we are introducing a patch that fixes bugs and improves gameplay!

[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Keys can no longer be used on other people's doors.
[*] The game no longer gets stuck when the story sequence is broken.
[*] Fixed the ability to move in a crouch over water when using a ladder.
[*] Increased the key model and updated its texture.
[/list]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Voiceover when closing the water.
[*] Sound when losing the key.
[*] Sound when finding the fuse.
[*] Sound when trying to turn on the light without a fuse.
[*] Sound when picking up the key to the warehouse.
[*] Sound when approaching the character to the door without the light on.
[*] Sound notifying that you can sit down.
[/list]

Thank you for playing our game! We continue to work on improvements and look forward to your feedback!

notes.title: The House of Lost Souls demo is available now at Steam Fest!
notes.content:
We are pleased to present you a demo of our new atmospheric game House of Lost Souls! One chapter is available in the demo where you can explore a mysterious house full of secrets and hidden details.

“House of Lost Souls is a game that focuses on atmospheric exploration. There are no clear objectives or directions - just listen to the character's voice, immerse yourself in the story and explore every corner of the house. Pay attention to details, because even the most insignificant things can turn out to be a clue.

We tried to create a unique atmosphere that will make you feel a part of this mysterious story. The full version of the game will reveal even more mysteries and immerse you in a world where every room keeps its secrets.

Try the demo right now and start your journey into the world of House of Lost Souls! We look forward to your impressions and feedback.

Download the demo and explore a house where every detail matters!

notes.title: Chapter One - My Memories
notes.content:
Welcome to all gamers and fans of cool games! 🌟  

🔥 Our broadcast is already in full swing, and we are waiting for you! 🔥  
Now you can see the exclusive gameplay of our game live — no editing, just an honest look at what awaits you! 🎥✨  

We share not only footage from the game, but also talk about its creation, mechanics and little secrets that make it special. Would you like to ask a question or leave your opinion? Write in the comments right now — we are reading and responding to everything! 💬  

Your impressions are incredibly important to us! We want to hear what you like and what can be improved.  

Don't miss the chance to join our gaming adventure right now. Click on the broadcast — we are waiting for you! 🕹️✨  

Get involved, it will be cool! 😉

notes.title: MosGhost
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265370/MosGhost/]MosGhost[/url]

After moving to Moscow, Andrey decides to rent a cheap apartment in an old Soviet house. But soon he begins to notice strange things that happen only at night. The shadows are moving, the sounds echo through the corridors, and the landlady of the apartment is clearly silent about something…

🔍 What is hidden in the walls of this old apartment?
💡 What secrets of the past await Andrei?
Will he be able to survive in this haunted house?

Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of mysticism and horror with Andrey! Explore the gloomy corners of the apartment, find hidden clues and solve creepy puzzles to uncover the terrible truth.

🎮 Test your nerves in the game “Secrets of the old apartment"!

Suitable for fans of horror and intricate plots.
🕹️ Intuitive controls and addictive gameplay.
An immersive story that keeps you in suspense until the very end.

Don't miss the chance to be a part of this frightening story! Uncover all the secrets of the old apartment and help Andrey survive this nightmare.
